verdict.rationale: All options fit the stated needs closely enough to be defensible, but none clearly dominates. A is cheapest and has the shortest drive plus breakfast; B has a better rating and a quiet work area; C has a restaurant and nominal four-star category; D has the highest rating and strongest evening-location appeal, while its parking cost is reimbursed. The prompt does not establish how Erin should trade commute time, rating, breakfast, work space, hotel character, and evening convenience.
